question: Ustad Bismillah Khan is a famous exponent of _____
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shehnai**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ustad Bismillah Khan** is a legendary figure known for his exceptional skill in playing the **Shehnai**.
 
• The Shehnai is a traditional Indian musical instrument, often used in weddings and religious ceremonies.
 
• Ustad Bismillah Khan has been credited with bringing the Shehnai into the mainstream of Indian classical music.
 
• His performances have earned him numerous awards, including the **Bharat Ratna**, India's highest civilian award.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ustad Bismillah Khan** was born on **March 21, 1916**, in** Dumraon, Bihar**.
 
• He performed at the **Red Fort in Delhi on the eve of India's independence in 1947**.
 
• Besides the Bharat Ratna, he received numerous other honors such as the** Padma Vibhushan, Padma Bhushan, and Padma Shri**.
 
• He passed away on August 21, 2006, but his legacy continues to inspire musicians worldwide.
